title: dETHroll
tagline: Introducing dETHroll – a nostalgic journey for some and an exciting new experience for others. Our innovation takes a beloved community-made mini-game from World of Warcraft and brings it to the blockchain, seamlessly integrating into Discord servers worldwide.
description:
We are introducing a thrilling community-made mini-game from World of Warcraft to the blockchain. This innovative creation not only taps into nostalgia but sets the stage for an entirely new gaming experience.

Picture your Discord server transformed into a dynamic battleground where players engage in intense duels for a shared cryptocurrency pool. The excitement mirrors classic dice-rolling dynamics, where two participants roll random numbers between 1 and 100. Player 1 initiates the duel, determining the starting point with their initial roll.

As the duel progresses, Player 2 enters the fray, rolling a number between 1 and the value established by Player 1's roll. Then it's back to Player 1 to roll a number between 1 and Player 2's number, and so on. The stakes rise with each roll, building tension until one player hits the elusive number 1, resulting in a high-stakes loss and forfeiture of the entire pool.
how_its_made:
Behind the scenes, dETHroll leverages powerful technologies to enhance user experience and ensure transparency. TheGraph indexes blockchain data for crucial player statistics, providing a comprehensive overview of in-game dynamics.

The backbone of our secure and transparent random number generation lies in API3's qRNG, ensuring fairness and unpredictability in every roll.

Our cutting-edge Discord bot is crafted with React and Next.js on the frontend and powered by NestJS and Discord.js on the backend.
